objective: On real knots with the engine of RING-IN-BALANCE-20261123-001A: the part of two members that returns beside a copy of itself under floor rations with a cancelling treatment; its counts by round under each treatment; the knot test at every birth under both knot laws; and which supplied rules the copying needs. First discriminator: the count of such parts by round against three frozen recurrences. Stop when every frozen prediction has a verdict.
status: Computed 2026-11-23, referee pending: under the rations FLOOR0, FLOOR1 and ONE-FEWER with a short knot joins cancelled, a part of two knots becomes two such parts every two rounds; the number of copies obeys N(t+2) = 2N(t) when the short knot retires, 2N(t) + N(t-1) when it makes an offshoot (golden ratio a round) and 2N(t) + N(t-2) when it waits (the Pell numbers). Every knot passes the knot test under both knot laws on the small starts. Under FLOOR1 a part copies itself in 85 to 97 percent of 3,344 starts of up to five knots and no knot fails. A fixed ration of three gives a five-member part that copies itself every round. With knots holding and the short knot waiting, a hand prediction failed: nothing copies and the growth jams.
title: Parts that copy themselves on real knots: the cycle, the counts, the knot test and the swaps
